statement:
The recorded value of **10 points possible** in the marking file is **not safe or correct** for posting as-is, because the column in Canvas is set for 100 points possible.

I will post the grades after converting the 10-point scores to 100-point equivalents.
judge_text:
WRONG
It asserts the value is "not safe or correct" because "the column in Canvas is set for 100 points possible" while scores are out of 10, and gives the fix (convert to 100-point equivalents).
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
